! Title: Google Search Slop Blocker (Full)
! Description: Blocks "AI Overview" and other LLM-powered features from Google Search.
! Homepage: https://github.com/SalaryTheft/gssb
! License: MIT
! Expires: 1 day
! Last modified: 2026-09-22

! AI Overview XHR
://www.google.com/async/folsrch?*$xhr
! AI Overview
google.com/search##div[data-cb-scope]
google.com##:matches-path(/^\/search(?:\?|$)/) div[data-cb-scope]
! Related searches and questions
google.com/search##div#bres
google.com/search##div[data-initq]
google.com##:matches-path(/^\/search(?:\?|$)/) div#bres
google.com##:matches-path(/^\/search(?:\?|$)/) div[data-initq]
! AI Mode Tab
google.com/search##div:has(>a[href*="udm=50"])
google.com##:matches-path(/^\/search(?:\?|$)/) div:has(>a[href*="udm=50"])
